about.title: About
about.intro: I work with C# .NET and SQL on a hospital system, where patient care, health records, and billing can't stop. I get along well with my team, other departments, and leadership. I usually help new developers through their first weeks on the team, so they can find their way around the project. I can explain technical issues in a way non-technical people understand, and I rarely say no when someone needs help.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.sinckDescription: Sinck Soluções is a company that partners with Benner Sistemas to offer ERP, HR, and Logistics management solutions for medium to large companies for over 20 years.
experiences.responsibilities: A summary of my responsibilities at the company:
experiences.sinckResponsibility1: Development of new routines for client systems, both in Desktop and web environments, using C# and .NET;
experiences.sinckResponsibility2: Creation of custom DLLs to meet specific project needs;
experiences.sinckResponsibility3: Use of SQL Server for queries and data manipulation;
experiences.sinckResponsibility4: Bug fixes and continuous system improvements;
experiences.sinckResponsibility5: Handling support calls for client technology support;
experiences.sinckResponsibility6: Update and management of Homologation and Production environments;
experiences.wakkeDescription: Wakke = Escolaweb is a complete school management system that has been serving institutions across Brazil for over 14 years. The software includes over 18 integrated modules, including an exclusive app that helps communication between school and family.
experiences.wakkeResponsibility1: Started as a front-end intern, working with Angular to develop responsive screens in Wakke systems;
experiences.wakkeResponsibility2: Hired as Developer I and II, expanded my responsibilities to back-end with C# and .NET in the development of REST APIs and adaptation of database procedures to C# code;
experiences.wakkeResponsibility3: Review of pull requests and process documentation, ensuring code quality and consistency;
experiences.wakkeResponsibility4: Ensuring a consistent and responsive user experience across different platforms and devices;
experiences.wakkeResponsibility5: Use of the DevExpress library to revamp the Escolaweb system in desktop environments.
experiences.bennerDescription: Benner is a leading technology provider for the healthcare, legal, ERP, logistics, and HR sectors. I work on ModernaNet, a hospital management ERP used by hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centers: patient services, electronic health records, TISS/ANS billing, finance, and inventory. Stack: C# .NET, ASP.NET MVC and Web API, Entity Framework, SQL Server, Oracle, JavaScript, and Azure DevOps.
experiences.bennerResponsibility1: End-to-end production support: analysis, reproduction, root cause, and minimal, safe fixes, ported across parallel releases;
experiences.bennerResponsibility2: TISS/ANS billing and health insurer integrations (claim forms, authorizations, and denials), including an authorization code integration;
experiences.bennerResponsibility3: Development of new features and settings based on each client's needs;
experiences.bennerResponsibility4: Scripts and queries in SQL Server and Oracle, plus support with client data migration;
experiences.bennerResponsibility5: Go-to developer on the team for urgent production issues, tracing problems across the front-end, back-end, and database to the root cause;
experiences.bennerResponsibility6: Migration of screens and logic from the legacy system Simah (Visual Basic) to ModernaNet (JavaScript and C# .NET);
experiences.bennerResponsibility7: AI-assisted development: Claude Code Skills and MCP Servers that review PRs against a guideline of about 55 rules and standardize team tasks, with governance rules to protect sensitive data;
experiences.bennerResponsibility8: Fix documentation for the QA team, plus training and onboarding of new developers;
